proposals.issue_title: Unreliable Image Generation & Missing Fallback Strategy
proposals.current_pain_description: HF is dead, Gemini is 429, AI Horde is 403. Pollinations is the only operational generator but outputs low-quality, non-stylized raw assets that are unmarketable. If Pollinations fails or outputs junk, the pipeline crashes or produces unusable products.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a unified gateway script (`image_generator_gateway.py`) implementing a strict priority queue: 1) Together AI (FLUX-schnell, free tier), 2) Cloudflare Workers AI (10k free neurons/day, SDXL/Flux), 3) Runware (PAYG, capped at $10/month via API key budget monitoring), 4) Pollinations as absolute fallback. Implement automated prompt-tuning per provider to guarantee high-contrast black & white lines for coloring books.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures zero pipeline crashes, shifts quality from raw/unusable to professional FLUX-schnell grade for < 5 EUR/month.

proposals.issue_title: Mobile Upload Bottleneck & Disorganized Metadata Packages
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has an Android phone and 10 hours/week. Downloading raw build artifacts from GitHub Actions and manually writing titles, descriptions, and tags on mobile for KDP/Redbubble/Cults3D is extremely slow, leading to a publishing bottleneck.
proposals.proposed_fix: Modify `agent_publisher` to auto-generate a `distribution_package.zip` for every run. This zip must contain: 1) Resized, optimized, and ready-to-upload assets, 2) A `metadata.json` and a formatted `copy_paste_helper.txt` containing platform-specific pre-optimized SEO titles, tags, descriptions, and pricing tailored for fast copy-pasting on mobile UI.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual publishing time per product on mobile from 25 minutes to less than 3 minutes, unlocking high-velocity listing.

proposals.issue_title: Silent API Failures and Lack of Mobile Monitoring
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions run headless. If an API key expires, rate-limits occur, or image generation fails, Hugo does not know until he manually checks GitHub logs on his phone web browser, wasting critical debugging time.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a lightweight Telegram/Discord webhook notification class inside `agent_orchestrator`. Send a rich text notification to Hugo's private mobile channel upon workflow completion, summarizing: Run Status (Success/Failure), number of assets generated, API cost spent, and a direct download link to the release artifact.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Instant feedback loop on Hugo's Android phone without navigating the complex GitHub UI.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Image Generation Caching leading to Wasted Budget
proposals.current_pain_description: If a 50-page coloring book pipeline crashes at page 45 due to a transient API timeout, restarting the GitHub Action regenerates all 45 pages from scratch. This wastes valuable daily API quotas, Together AI limits, or Runware cash.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a lightweight SQLite database or file-based JSON cache (`generation_cache.json`) in the workspace. Commit intermediate successful asset generation states back to a temporary git branch or use GitHub Actions Cache. Before calling any generation API, check if the specific prompt/asset hash already exists in the cache.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves up to 80% of API quotas and compute time on failed/retried pipeline runs.

proposals.current_pain_description: Generated images do not respect physical print formats (e.g., KDP 8.5x11 inches bleed/no-bleed margins). Raw outputs from AI generators are usually 1:1 square. If compiled raw, Amazon KDP will reject the PDF during review, causing high manual rework rates.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate an automated Pillow-based pre-flight canvas adapter inside the PDF compilation step. Automatically resize, pad to 300 DPI, add standard KDP margins (0.25 inch bleed safety zone), and convert to grayscale/CMYK color space before compiling images into the final PDF.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero KDP print-on-demand rejections due to formatting/sizing issues, ensuring automated compliance.

proposals.issue_title: Missed Cross-Pollination of Assets Across Platforms
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines run in silos. A high-quality line-art illustration generated for a coloring book is never reused as a vector SVG pack for Etsy, a transparent PNG for Redbubble stickers, or extruded into a 3D cookie cutter for Cults3D.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a post-generation multiplexer script (`agent_vertical_optimizer`). For every high-quality black-and-white asset generated: 1) Convert to transparent PNG (via Pillow/rembg) for Merch, 2) Vectorize to SVG (via potrace) for Etsy SVG packs, 3) Auto-generate a simple OpenSCAD script to extrude the SVG profile into a 3D printable STL for Cults3D.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 4x multiplier on digital assets produced per hour of API compute time.

proposals.issue_title: Gemini API Rate Limiting (HTTP 429) Under Heavy Load
proposals.current_pain_description: Using multiple parallel agents on GitHub Actions using the free Gemini tier triggers immediate 429 rate limit errors, breaking orchestrations midway.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a centralized API client wrapper with built-in client-side rate-limiting using token bucket algorithms and exponential backoff with jitter (e.g., `tenacity` library or custom loop), spacing out LLM calls to never exceed 15 RPM (Requests Per Minute).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Completely mitigates HTTP 429 crash failures across all LLM-reliant agents.
